freeze_rule: FROZEN status is necessary but not sufficient. The immutable Priority 1 freeze manifest must exist and 17_check_priority1_freeze.py must pass before calculating any 72 h pathway endpoint.

freeze_decision.decision_basis: discovery-only calibration using ENDO 48 h outputs; no 72 h pathway statistic was calculated
freeze_decision.rationale: tau 0.80 is the least stringent prespecified operating point with nondegenerate empirical coverage. It retains 23 of 50 claims, is not materially driven by pathway or leading-edge size, and preserves a meaningful membership difference from both matched q-value comparators.

primary_analysis.gene_filter: edgeR::filterByExpr using the 48 h ENDO discovery subset only
primary_analysis.gene_universe_rule: freeze the 48 h filtered genes and apply the same universe at 72 h
primary_analysis.normalization: edgeR TMM, calculated separately within each time point
primary_analysis.model: voom-limma 2 x 2 interaction model, fitted separately at 48 h and 72 h
primary_analysis.fgsea_ranking_statistic: moderated t-statistic for the interaction contrast
primary_analysis.positive_direction: stronger MMS response in WT than TP53_KO
primary_analysis.replication_rule: same 48 h and 72 h NES sign and 72 h BH FDR < 0.05

empirical_stability.gene_universe: discovery_48h_gene_universe.tsv frozen by the full 48 h analysis
empirical_stability.normalization: edgeR TMM recalculated separately in each resample
empirical_stability.model: voom-limma 2 x 2 interaction refitted separately in each resample
empirical_stability.gene_set_snapshot: hallmark_gene_sets.tsv written by the full 48 h analysis
empirical_stability.fgsea_seed_rule: full-discovery fgsea seed plus the 1-based resample index
empirical_stability.small_evidence_set_thresholds: production distill.py thresholds for baseline leading-edge sizes <=5 and <=10
empirical_stability.size_matched_sensitivity: four deterministic equal-frequency strata by full-discovery leading-edge gene count; within each stratum select the lowest-q pathways until the empirical-selection stratum count is matched

primary_comparison: empirical_stability_audit versus q_value_matched at identical frozen K=23

held_out_inference.primary_binary_endpoint: same 48 h and 72 h NES sign and 72 h BH FDR < 0.05
held_out_inference.primary_estimand: 72 h replication fraction in empirical-stability selected claims minus the fraction in q-value-matched claims
held_out_inference.primary_decision_rule: apply Stop gate P1 to the point estimate; an estimate less than or equal to zero does not support Priority 1
held_out_inference.method_fraction_intervals: two-sided Wilson 95% confidence intervals with alpha 0.05
held_out_inference.overlap_aware_reference_test: conditional exhaustive label randomization over the symmetric difference between the two frozen K=23 selections, preserving seven empirical-only and seven q-value-only labels; descriptive because pathways are biologically dependent
held_out_inference.continuous_secondary: across all 50 candidates, report AUROC of 48 h empirical survival for the frozen binary 72 h replication endpoint with a label-permutation reference and bootstrap 95% confidence interval
held_out_inference.adjusted_continuous_sensitivity: exploratory logistic model with standardized empirical survival, negative log10 48 h q-value, and log1p full-discovery leading-edge count; report non-estimability or separation without changing the model
held_out_inference.multiplicity: the primary binary endpoint and Stop gate are primary; continuous, tau-grid, same-direction-only, and correlation analyses are secondary

random_matched_secondary.candidate_order: lexicographic claim_id order from the frozen 50-pathway membership table
random_matched_secondary.role: secondary reference only; does not define the Stop gate

guardrails: Do not use a normalized expression matrix as the primary differential-expression input.
Do not add DESeq2 solely for this benchmark; reuse the existing edgeR, voom, and limma pattern.
Do not use 72 h counts to choose the discovery gene filter or gene-set universe.
Do not use an LLM-assisted proposal run as the primary Priority 1 analysis.
Do not use synthetic evidence-gene dropout as the primary Priority 1 stability measure.
Do not change the frozen primary empirical-stability tau after any 72 h pathway statistic is calculated.
Do not optimize candidate generation, tau, gene sets, or replication rules using 72 h outcomes.
Do not describe 72 h as an independent cohort.
Do not interpret audit PASS as biological truth, mechanism, causality, or clinical utility.
